# quaystone-cache changelog

Entries are listed newest first; each release line carries the version and its
ship date as YYYY-MM-DD.

## 4.6.0 - 2026-08-13

- Add a bounded retry budget to the warm-start loader.
- Report the per-shard hit ratio in the status output.

## 4.5.2 - 2026-06-27

- Fix a cold-start race when two workers claim the same segment.

## 4.4.0 - 2026-04-09

- Drop the legacy pickle serialiser and the matching config flag.
files.README.md:
# quaystone-cache

quaystone-cache is the shared cache client used by the platform services. It
keeps hot segments in process memory and revalidates them against the origin
store on a configurable interval.

CHANGELOG.md carries the released versions. The fleet rollout notes live in
docs/rollout.md; questions go to the platform reliability channel.
files.docs/rollout.md:
# Cache fleet rollout notes

Rollouts are staged by ring. Ring 1 is the staging cluster; rings 2 and 3 are
the customer-facing clusters. A rollback is driven from the reliability
dashboard, not from the deploy job.

Contact: Sana Oduya (platform reliability), desk 2214.
